name: Made to Move
thesis: Raygen’s love of making things becomes a tactile, full-width mechanical playground in lilac and electric lime.
interaction: Drag the arm’s endpoint to solve a two-link inverse-kinematics pose, or use keyboard-accessible shoulder and elbow sliders with exact forward kinematics; reset returns the opening pose.
why: A real mechanism gives visitors a small taste of engineering play before introducing SERV0, DAVID, and Hack Club—without presenting the illustration as a real project.
